headline: WNBA Playoffs Tip-Off: Round 1 Game 1 quadruple-header underway
whyCareReason: The 2026 WNBA postseason tips off today with four Game 1 clashes as Caitlin Clark and the Fever visit Atlanta while Minnesota hosts Washington.
teaser: Sunday 27 September: WNBA Playoffs Round 1 begins with Game 1 quadruple-header. Lynx, Valkyries, Aces, and Fever open best-of-three series.
story:
Why this one matters: Sunday 27 September marks the official launch of the 2026 WNBA postseason with four blockbuster Game 1 encounters.

At Target Center, the top-seeded Minnesota Lynx (32-10) host the Washington Mystics, leaning on their elite defense to set the tone. At Gateway Center Arena, Caitlin Clark leads the fifth-seeded Indiana Fever into a hostile environment against the fourth-seeded Atlanta Dream in the day's marquee matchup.

Later, the second-year Golden State Valkyries host the New York Liberty at Chase Center, while the two-time defending champion Las Vegas Aces take on the Dallas Wings in Vegas. Every series is best-of-three, making Game 1 a near-must-win.
stakes: Opening-round best-of-three series begin today. Winning Game 1 provides a 78% historical advantage in the series.
rivalryAngle: Top-seeded Lynx and defending champion Aces face surging challengers in a loaded eight-team field.
